{{Quote|We're almost free, but a surprise attack... snow melted by Togruta blood. We're all that's left.|Lodish|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Lodish''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed in [[Aurek Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] along with other Togrutas, they were ready to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and return to [[Shili/Legends|Shili]] in [[3642 BBY]], when an Imperial attack on their encampment left them without passes off-world. Because it took months for new ones to arrive, Lodish asked a Republic citizen to retrieve their passes from an Imperial-overrun camp instead.<ref name="TogrutaRescue" />
